localizedText.descOrderLimit: Maximum number of simultaneous report generations.
localizedText.descSignatureCertificate: Signature certificates can be created with Adobe Acrobat. Instruction: https://helpx.adobe.com/acrobat/using/digital-ids.html
localizedText.descSignatureKey: Key which is used to add a digital signature to the report.
localizedText.descExportPath: Path to generated reports. Default: Extension directory
localizedText.descOverwriteReports: Only one report exists at a time. The old one is overwritten when a new one is generated.
localizedText.descRemoveRemoteFile: Remove the report on the reporting server system after download.
localizedText.descRuntimes: Connections to reporting servers can be configured here.
localizedText.descParentTag: The HTML tag under which the file should be included.
localizedText.descScriptFile: JavaScript files to be executed can be uploaded here.
localizedText.descDefaultData: This object can be used to define data objects to be presented in each report.
localizedText.descDataConfigurations: Can be used to sort and individualize the data that is sent dynamically from the Reporting Clients.
localizedText.descSortPriority: Specifies the position of the data object in the report
localizedText.descRoundTo: Provides the option to round floating-point numbers to a specified decimal place.
localizedText.descTimestampFormat: Provides the option to convert Timestamp to a specified format. By default, the following formatting is selected: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.ffff"
localizedText.descAddress: Provides the ability to send the report to multiple email addresses.
localizedText.descUseBCC: Provides the option to set the email addresses in BCC.
localizedText.descText: Provides the option to specify a specific email text. This text replaces the default email text.
localizedText.descSignatureConfiguration: Signing reports is only available if the reporting server has the full license (no trial license).
localizedText.Name: Name
localizedText.title: Title
localizedText.descFilter: The results can be filtered with comparisons (Example: "prop::a == 5").
localizedText.descOrderBy: The results can be sorted (Example: "timestamp ASC").
localizedText.descLimit: The results can be limited to a certain number.
localizedText.descColumns: Columns to be shown in the report.
localizedText.descValue: A pattern for custom columns can be added here. The readValue properties are accessible in curly brackets.
localizedText.reportPreviewTitle: Preview of your last generated report
localizedText.descGenerationTimeout: Specifies the longest duration to wait for the report to be generated.
localizedText.signatureMissingLicenseMsg: Signing reports is only available with full reporting server license.
